hobbies that will make you
impossible to manipulate

playing poker

play friendly poker with friends once a month. reading bluffs and pressure at the table teaches you to spot the same tricks in real life conversations.

studying persuasion

read one classic book on persuasion and influence. once you can name the techniques, salespeople and manipulators lose almost all of their power over you.

journaling decisions

write down why you made each big decision. reading it back weeks later shows you exactly when you were pushed by emotion or pressure instead of reason.

learning how minds work

spend 5 minutes a day learning one idea from psychology: anchoring, social proof, the scarcity trap. you can't be fooled by a trick you already understand.

learning how minds work

i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app about how minds work: anchoring, social proof, scarcity. you can't be fooled by a trick you already understand.

slides.texte_overlay:
sleeping on offers

make it a rule never to accept a big offer on the same day. pressure to decide right now is the oldest trick there is, and one night beats it almost every time.
